name: Image Generator
description: Generates image artifacts through configured cloud or approved local providers. Provider selection is explicit or uses the configured default.
brief: Use the `image-generator` skill only after an administrator enables it and configures an approved provider. The `generate_image` tool accepts an explicit provider or uses the configured default provider.
author: Evonic

variables.name: default_provider
variables.label: Default Provider
variables.description: Provider ID used when generate_image does not specify a provider. It must identify an enabled provider from the provider registry.

variables.name: allowed_providers
variables.label: Allowed Providers
variables.description: Comma-separated provider IDs permitted for this skill. Keep this allowlist limited to reviewed cloud or local providers.

variables.name: allow_local_providers
variables.label: Allow Approved Local Providers
variables.description: When enabled, permits providers declared as local only when they also appear in Allowed Providers.

variables.name: automatic1111_endpoint
variables.label: AUTOMATIC1111 Endpoint
variables.description: Administrator-approved base URL for the local AUTOMATIC1111-compatible API. Agents cannot override it.

variables.name: automatic1111_trusted_hosts
variables.label: AUTOMATIC1111 Trusted Hosts
variables.description: Comma-separated exact endpoint hostnames approved by an administrator. Required when enabling the local provider.

variables.name: automatic1111_timeout_seconds
variables.label: AUTOMATIC1111 Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Bounded request timeout for the local provider, from 1 through 120 seconds.

variables.name: automatic1111_steps
variables.label: AUTOMATIC1111 Default Steps
variables.description: Administrator-controlled fixed generation step count for the local provider, from 1 through 100.

variables.name: google_gemini_api_key
variables.label: Google Gemini API Key
variables.description: Write-only Google Generative Language API credential used only by the approved Google Gemini provider.

variables.name: google_gemini_timeout_seconds
variables.label: Google Gemini Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Bounded request timeout for Google Gemini, from 1 through 120 seconds.

variables.name: max_images_per_request
variables.label: Maximum Images Per Request
variables.description: Upper limit for images requested in a single generation call.

variables.name: provider_api_key
variables.label: Provider API Key
variables.description: Optional provider credential. It is reserved for future production adapters and is never returned in tool results.
